title: MxAgile Page YAML
description: A structured, semantic representation of a UI mockup page. Produced by the UI-Agent Analyze mode. Consumed by the Implementation-Agent and UI-Agent Verify mode.

source_mockup.description: Relative path to the original (immutable) source HTML mockup file. Never modified after acceptance. See policies/mockup-lifecycle.md.

mockup_type.description: Classification of the source mockup. static=pure HTML/CSS, no JavaScript materially changes visible content/layout/structure — one browser render per viewport is sufficient. executable=JavaScript drives role-dependent content, dynamic states, or data-dependent layout — each materially distinct scenario requires separate browser execution. unknown=cannot determine from source alone; treat as executable. See policies/mockup-materialization.md.

target_mockup.description: Relative path to the ACTIVE acceptance target mockup used for implementation and verification. When absent, source_mockup is also the target. Set when a refined target differs from the original source. See policies/mockup-lifecycle.md.

mockup_name.description: Name of the SPA mockup bundle this screen belongs to. Matches the directory name under planning/target-mockups/<mockup-name>/ and input-resources/ui-ux/<mockup-name>/. Required when ui_driven=true and the source is a SPA bundle. Absent for single-file legacy mockups. Enables Bundle -> Screen relationship in the artifact index.

target_revision.description: Optional: the accepted revision ID of the target mockup bundle. Set when a SPA bundle revision was accepted. Links to planning/target-mockups/<mockup-name>/_history/<target_revision>/revision.yaml. Absent for single-file legacy targets or when no revision has been accepted yet.

bundle_hash.description: Optional: deterministic SHA-256 hash of the target bundle at the time of last accepted revision. See policies/spa-mockup-bundle.md for the canonical algorithm. Used for staleness detection when the active working bundle diverges from the accepted revision.

target_mockup_version.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the last accepted change to the target mockup. For legacy single-file targets only. For SPA bundles use target_revision instead.

target_mockup_reason.description: Human-readable reason for the last target mockup change. e.g. 'Refined after round-1 parity findings — content labels corrected'.

platform_boundary.description: True if this page belongs to a platform module (e.g. MB_SSO authentication). Platform-boundary pages are NOT derived as fachliche application pages. They do not generate REQ-NNN, SPEC-NNN, or tasks. They are excluded from UI-parity campaigns. See policies/mockup-lifecycle.md § Platform Boundary Scope Rule.

layout_reference.description: Path to the canonical reference screenshot for this page. Set by UI-Agent Analyze. Used by Implementation-Agent and UI-Agent Verify.

ui_pattern.description: Identified UI pattern BEFORE any Mendix widget is named. A UI pattern is not yet a Mendix widget. e.g., dense_analytical_table, responsive_record_list, card_collection, read_only_detail_panel, form, kpi_tile_group, label_value_summary. See policies/ui-element-selection.md — UI Pattern Examples.

display_mode.description: Semantic mode of this component. display=presents information only; input=invites user to change values; mixed=contains both display and input elements. Drives widget selection: display components must not default to input controls.

widget_candidate.description: Proposed Mendix widget or component for this component. A HYPOTHESIS at preliminary confidence — not a decided implementation. e.g., DataGrid2, ListView, Container, custom:CompanyCardWidget. Must be advanced to assessed confidence before gate-to-ready.

candidate_confidence.description: Confidence level of the widget_candidate. preliminary=initial guess from pattern, not yet checked against fit criteria; assessed=fit criteria evaluated and rationale documented; validated=confirmed in running browser with representative data and correct role.

fit_rationale.description: Required when candidate_confidence is assessed or validated. Summarizes the fit criteria evaluation: why this widget/component satisfies the visual, interaction, responsive, and role contract for this component. For Data Grid 2 candidates must reference the 10-point fit check. See policies/ui-element-selection.md.

type.description: e.g., text, number, date, dropdown, checkbox

visual_priority.description: Visual prominence of the action in the mockup.

triggers.description: e.g., opens a page, calls a microflow, closes page

navigation.description: Typed navigation relationships originating from this page. Each entry maps an action to its target page.

action_id.description: The ACT- id that triggers the navigation (must match an action defined in sections.components.actions).

leads_to_page.description: Target page name or page_id. Must correspond to a page in the ui-inventory.

condition.description: Optional guard condition under which this navigation fires (e.g., 'only when IsValid = true').

interaction_states.description: Meaningful UI states captured during mockup analysis (e.g., empty state, error state, loading, expanded tab). Each state may carry a list of effects describing what happens when that state is entered or triggered.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this state represents.

interaction_type.description: Semantic classification of this interaction state. Used by downstream agents to categorise and verify interactions systematically. expandable_area: collapsible sections (e.g. CapTrack Gesamtübersicht Abteilungsbereiche, Zielkarten). modal: full overlay dialog. popup: inline or anchored overlay. snippet: embedded content revealed on another page context. filter: filter/search applied. hover_state: content visible only on hover. keyboard: keyboard-triggered state. read_only: view-only mode for normally editable content. disabled: control present but non-interactive. validation: form validation error state. success_feedback: positive action confirmation. error_feedback: negative action result. loading: async loading in progress. empty: no data available. role_dependent: state differs by authenticated role. other: does not fit a defined type.

trigger.description: What causes this state (e.g., 'no records found', 'Name field left empty and Save clicked', 'user clicks Abteilung expand arrow').

screenshot.description: Path to mockup screenshot of this state under .concord/screenshots/mockup/.

trigger.description: Structured trigger descriptor for this interaction state.

key.description: Keyboard key name when type=keyboard, e.g. 'Enter', 'Space', 'Escape', 'ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown'. Null otherwise.

label.description: Free-text description of the trigger for human readability, e.g. 'User clicks Expand arrow on Abteilung row'.

initial_state.description: Description of the UI state before this interaction is triggered.

resulting_state.description: Description of the UI state after this interaction is triggered.

visual_feedback.description: Observable visual change (e.g., 'Expand arrow rotates 90°, section slides open').

data_effect.description: Effect on data — saved, discarded, loaded, filtered, etc.

navigation_effect.description: Navigation that occurs as part of this state (e.g., 'Navigates to PAGE-ZIELMANAGEMENT').

permission_effect.description: How role/permission affects this state (e.g., 'Only visible for E3 and above').

focus_effect.description: Where focus moves after this interaction (e.g., 'Focus moves to first input in dialog').

persistence.description: Whether the resulting state persists across navigations. none=resets on navigate. local=preserved in local storage. session=preserved for session. persisted=saved to backend.

suggested_mendix_mechanisms.description: Proposed Mendix implementation approaches — candidates only, not confirmed requirements.

platform_boundary.description: True if this screen belongs to a platform module (e.g. MB_SSO). Platform-boundary screens are excluded from fachliche page derivation and UI parity campaigns.

effects.description: Machine-readable list of UI effects that occur when this state is triggered. Effects describe observable changes to the UI — not internal implementation details.

effect_id.description: Stable identifier for this effect, e.g. EFF-ABTEILUNG-EXPAND.

target.description: The UI element or area affected by this effect. Reference a component id, section id, or descriptive label (e.g. 'SEC-ABTEILUNG-BODY', 'COMP-ZIELKARTE-DETAILS', 'Mitarbeitermatrix').

description.description: Human-readable description of what this effect does and what becomes visible or hidden.

reversible.description: True if the effect can be undone by re-triggering (e.g. collapse re-hides expanded content). False for one-way effects (e.g. form submission navigates away).

precondition.description: Optional: condition that must hold for this effect to apply (e.g. 'only when user has role E3 or higher', 'only when Basisjahr is expanded first').

derived_page.description: Explicit marker that this effect does NOT require a separate Mendix page. Set to false when the content appears as an inline expandable area, snippet, or popup on the current page — prevents automatic page derivation by downstream agents.

required_action.description: Action required by downstream agents (Refinement, Implementation, Acceptance) when this effect is present. UPDATE_REQUIRED: modify existing artifact; NEW_IMPLEMENTATION: create new artifact (developer confirmation required); REMOVE_AS_SUPERSEDED: mark/remove superseded artifact; REGRESSION_REQUIRED: no model change but test must re-run; DISCOVERY_REQUIRED: block until discovery complete; DECISION_REQUIRED: block until developer decides; NO_ACTION: no change needed.

downstream_artifacts.description: IDs of downstream artifacts affected by this effect (e.g. REQ-NNN, SPEC-NNN, TASK-NNN).

affected_roles.description: Role IDs affected by this effect (e.g. ROLE-E3-EINTRAGUNG). Empty = all roles.

affected_screens.description: Screen/page IDs affected by this effect.

source_ids.description: IDs of requirements or decisions that require this effect.
